scope: Standalone POSIX durable evidence component plus mock faults and one pinned historical negative control.
known_trace_requires: strict hash-chain and event-order replay from on-disk bytes
exact producer IDs/response against on-disk replay
closed result/manifest equality with JSON types preserved
durable immutable-name files and atomic no-replace terminal publication
trusted external terminal digest and complete post-save readback
acceptance_scope: trace_complete is not format acceptance, semantic equivalence, sampling correctness or evidence of actual model execution; only returned verified bytes may be submitted to a separately frozen format validator.
failure_policy: Any validation/I/O error leaves evidence UNKNOWN and forbids same-directory reopen/resume/retry. Preserve observed files.
requirements_before_native_v2: new runner and protocol integrating this gate with the separately identified format-v2 validator
pin all source/public resources and candidate requests in Git before generation
read back source/intent and record exactly one attempt outcome
freeze cohort, sampling, token/time bounds, failure/abstention policy
independent native trace/sampling and post-save audit
Coordinator must persist attempt-ID ownership and forbid creating a new directory to rerun the same physical attempt.
